title.en: An Act Requiring the Payment of the Regular Daily Wages of Government Laborers and Employees During All Special Public Holidays, Whether Local or National
title.orig: An Act Requiring the Payment of the Regular Daily Wages of Government Laborers and Employees During All Special Public Holidays, Whether Local or National

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4622_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, all laborers and employees of the Philippine Government, whether on the national, provincial, local or city level, including laborers and employees of government-owned or controlled corporations, whether their employment is permanent or temporary in nature , shall be paid their regular daily wages during all special Public holidays, local or national.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
